messages:
sophia_prod: FYI customer AcmeCorp flagged invoice INV-2026-0456 — they require a PO and the card on file was declined. Also their credit note calculation looks off: our CN shows -$120.00 but the customer expects -$100.00. VAT handling also seems wrong (invoice had 20% VAT but CN shows 0%). cc @emma_finance @liam_support

emma_finance: thanks — can you paste the invoice id (got it), customer billing country, PO number, and whether the card actually charged? need last 4 for payment gateway check.

liam_support: repro notes: customer downgraded from Pro-1000 to Pro-500 on 2026-02-28 (mid-cycle). Our proration call returned a credit of 120.00 USD in the API response but accounting ledger recorded 100.00 USD. Quick snippet from the adjustment payload we saw: 
```json
{"invoice_id":"INV-2026-0456","proration_amount_cents":-12000,"currency":"USD","promo_adjustment_cents":-2000}
```
It looks like promos were handled differently between billing service and ledger. Also payment gateway shows last card attempt failed with decline code `card_declined`.

billing-bot: Automated: Created credit note CN-2026-009 for INV-2026-0456 amount -120.00 USD. Payment gateway refund: false.

emma_finance: initial read: CN shows -120.00 USD and VAT 0% because account tax_exempt flag = true. Sales says they provided PO #PO-7782 with reverse-charge (EU). If reverse-charge applies, VAT should be 0% but finance needs the PO on record. Also because payment was declined, we should not attempt a card refund — issue credit note and link to PO so it applies to next invoice or can be refunded when requested.

maria_sales: confirming PO #PO-7782 is valid and signed. They expect net credit of 100.00 USD because their internal calculation excluded a promotional credit on the original invoice (promo was applied after proration in their view). So we need to reconcile which promo rules to use.

oliver_ops: I can take this. Proposed remediation steps: 1) void CN-2026-009, 2) recalc proration including promo tags, 3) create a corrected credit note and link to PO, 4) update ledger with manual journal if necessary. Command I plan to run: `scripts/billing/recalc_prorate --invoice INV-2026-0456 --include-promos true --output-cents` — will need finance approval before creating the new CN. ETA ~1h.

emma_finance: approved. Use manual journal template: DR AccountsReceivable 100.00 USD / CR Revenue 100.00 USD. Tax 0 due to reverse-charge. Add memo: 'PO-7782 reverse charge; corrected proration incl promo'. For the customer-facing side, send the `partial_refund_po` email template and note that credit will be applied to next invoice since card was declined.

liam_support: filing a bug for engineering: proration engine excludes promo credits when computing mid-cycle downgrades on monthly cycles — ticket BILL-3284. I'll add repro steps and sample payload.

oliver_ops: ran recalc and reconciliation: `recalc_prorate` output -> new proration net credit -10000 cents. Voided CN-2026-009 (reason: incorrect promo handling). Created CN-2026-010 for -100.00 USD (VAT 0%). Linked CN-2026-010 to PO-7782 and set `apply_to_next_invoice=true`. Updated ledger with journal JRN-7891.

billing-bot: Audit log: CN-2026-009 voided by oliver_ops at 1967890450. CN-2026-010 created by oliver_ops at 1967890510. Journal JRN-7891 posted at 1967890520.

sophia_prod: Thanks everyone — customer notified, PO-linked credit applied to next invoice, email sent. Closing the support ticket and marking as resolved.

emma_finance: one follow-up: please attach copy of PO and CN-2026-010 to the customer record and to the manual refund queue (for when customer requests an actual refund vs credit). Also finance will reconcile with FY month close.

liam_support: noted — ticket updated with attachments and bug ref.

sophia_prod: closing now, will reopen if customer escalates. :white_check_mark:
